description: Flat metadata schema for individual records describing fungal biosynthetic gene clusters and associated secondary metabolite production, including organism/sample context, sequencing and assembly provenance, cluster-level annotations, gene-level roles, and metabolite chemical analysis.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the metadata record (e.g., BGC record or BGC-metabolite-linked record). Use a stable accession-like string.

sample_id.descr: Identifier for the fungal sample or isolate from which DNA and metabolites were obtained.

isolate_id.descr: Identifier for the fungal isolate/strain, if different from sample_id.

organism_scientific_name.descr: Full scientific name of the fungal organism (genus, species, and if available strain designation).

organism_taxon_id.descr: NCBI Taxonomy ID or equivalent controlled taxonomy identifier for the fungal organism.

fungal_phylum.descr: Taxonomic phylum of the fungus, preferably using a controlled term (e.g., Ascomycota, Basidiomycota).

fungal_class.descr: Taxonomic class of the fungus, preferably using a controlled term.

fungal_order.descr: Taxonomic order of the fungus, preferably using a controlled term.

fungal_family.descr: Taxonomic family of the fungus, preferably using a controlled term.

sample_source.descr: Origin of the fungal material (e.g., soil, plant endophyte, marine sponge-associated, clinical isolate).

host_organism.descr: Host or substrate associated with the fungus, if applicable (e.g., plant species, insect, sediment).

geographic_location.descr: Sampling location in a human-readable form (e.g., country, region, site).

collection_date.descr: Date when the fungal sample was collected or isolated.

culture_conditions.descr: Culture medium and/or growth conditions used for fungal cultivation prior to DNA extraction or metabolite production, if applicable.

dna_extraction_method.descr: Method or kit used to extract fungal DNA.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing platform used for whole-genome sequencing (e.g., Illumina, PacBio, Oxford Nanopore).

library_preparation_method.descr: Library preparation method used for genomic sequencing.

read_layout.descr: Sequencing read layout (e.g., paired-end, single-end, long-read).

genome_assembly_accession.descr: Accession or identifier for the genome assembly used in biosynthetic gene cluster discovery.

assembly_level.descr: Assembly contiguity level (e.g., contig, scaffold, chromosome).

assembly_length_bp.descr: Total assembled genome length in base pairs (bp).

gc_content_percent.descr: Genome GC content expressed as percentage (%).

coverage_depth_x.descr: Approximate mean sequencing coverage depth of the genome assembly (X-fold).

annotation_pipeline.descr: Software pipeline or workflow used for genome annotation and/or BGC prediction (e.g., antiSMASH version, custom pipeline).

bgc_id.descr: Unique identifier for the biosynthetic gene cluster within the record.

bgc_contig_id.descr: Contig, scaffold, or chromosome identifier on which the biosynthetic gene cluster is located.

bgc_start_bp.descr: 1-based start coordinate of the biosynthetic gene cluster on the contig/scaffold/chromosome (bp).

bgc_end_bp.descr: 1-based end coordinate of the biosynthetic gene cluster on the contig/scaffold/chromosome (bp).

bgc_length_bp.descr: Length of the biosynthetic gene cluster region in base pairs (bp).

bgc_cluster_class.descr: Broad biosynthetic class of the cluster (e.g., polyketide, nonribosomal peptide, terpene, hybrid PKS-NRPS, RiPP, indole).

bgc_prediction_tool.descr: Tool or method used to identify the biosynthetic gene cluster.

bgc_prediction_version.descr: Version of the BGC prediction tool or pipeline.

bgc_confidence_score.descr: Numeric confidence score for the BGC prediction or annotation, if available.

cluster_novelty_status.descr: Novelty assessment of the BGC (e.g., known, putative novel, highly novel).

closest_known_cluster.descr: Name or accession of the closest known reference cluster, if similarity-based annotation was performed.

similarity_percent.descr: Percent similarity to the closest known cluster, if applicable.

gene_count_in_cluster.descr: Number of genes annotated within the BGC.

core_biosynthetic_gene_id.descr: Identifier of the core biosynthetic gene in the cluster (e.g., PKS, NRPS, terpene synthase).

core_biosynthetic_gene_name.descr: Gene name or locus tag of the core biosynthetic gene.

core_biosynthetic_gene_product.descr: Predicted product/type of the core biosynthetic enzyme (e.g., polyketide synthase, nonribosomal peptide synthetase).

gene_locus_tag.descr: Locus tag or gene identifier for a gene within the cluster. If the record is cluster-level, this may denote the focal gene.

gene_start_bp.descr: 1-based start coordinate of the gene on the contig/scaffold/chromosome (bp).

gene_end_bp.descr: 1-based end coordinate of the gene on the contig/scaffold/chromosome (bp).

gene_strand.descr: Gene strand orientation relative to the reference sequence ('+' or '-').

gene_function_annotation.descr: Functional annotation of the gene product within the biosynthetic pathway (e.g., backbone enzyme, tailoring enzyme, transporter, regulator).

gene_ec_number.descr: Enzyme Commission (EC) number, if assigned to the gene product.

gene_domain_architecture.descr: Domain architecture or conserved motifs for the gene product (e.g., KS-AT-ACP, A-T-C, Cytochrome P450).

gene_prediction_support.descr: Evidence supporting gene annotation (e.g., homology, domain prediction, transcript support).

ortholog_group_id.descr: Ortholog or gene family identifier, if assigned, to support comparative analysis across clusters.

metabolite_id.descr: Unique identifier for the isolated or detected secondary metabolite linked to the record.

metabolite_name.descr: Common or systematic name of the secondary metabolite, if known.

metabolite_class.descr: Chemical class of the metabolite (e.g., alkaloid, polyketide, peptide, terpenoid, hybrid).

metabolite_inchi.descr: InChI string for the metabolite structure, if determined.

metabolite_inchikey.descr: InChIKey for the metabolite structure, if determined.

metabolite_smiles.descr: SMILES representation of the metabolite structure, if determined.

metabolite_formula.descr: Molecular formula of the metabolite, if determined.

metabolite_exact_mass_da.descr: Exact monoisotopic mass of the metabolite in daltons (Da), if determined.

metabolite_yield_mg_l.descr: Observed yield or titer of the metabolite in mg/L, if measured.

metabolite_purity_percent.descr: Purity of the isolated metabolite expressed as percentage (%), if measured.

analytical_method.descr: Analytical technique used to detect, isolate, or characterize the metabolite (e.g., LC-MS, GC-MS, NMR, HPLC).

ms_mz_value.descr: Observed mass-to-charge ratio (m/z) for the metabolite or diagnostic ion, if measured.

ms_retention_time_min.descr: Chromatographic retention time in minutes, if measured.

nmr_method.descr: NMR method used for structural elucidation, if applicable (e.g., 1H NMR, 13C NMR, COSY, HSQC, HMBC).

bioactivity_assay.descr: Bioassay or activity screen used to evaluate the metabolite (e.g., antimicrobial, cytotoxicity, enzyme inhibition).

bioactivity_result.descr: Outcome of the bioactivity assay (e.g., active, inactive, partial activity, not tested).

bioactivity_measurement.descr: Quantitative bioactivity value, if available (e.g., IC50, MIC, EC50).

bioactivity_units.descr: Units for the quantitative bioactivity measurement (e.g., uM, ug/mL, nM).

industrial_application_potential.descr: Potential application area for the metabolite or pathway (e.g., drug discovery, agriculture, enzyme inhibitor, pigment, biocontrol).

evidence_linking_bgc_to_metabolite.descr: Description of the evidence linking the BGC to the metabolite (e.g., gene knockout, heterologous expression, correlation, isotope labeling).

linking_confidence_score.descr: Numeric confidence score for the BGC-to-metabolite linkage, if available.

publication_doi.descr: DOI of the publication or report describing the record, if available.

database_accession.descr: External database accession for the sequence, cluster, or metabolite record, if available.

record_created_date.descr: Date when this metadata record was created.

record_updated_date.descr: Date when this metadata record was last updated.
